      May is a special month for us. We both celebrate our birthdays in May, and now we get to celebrate our marriage in May too. It feels like the month was always meant to be ours. 
We will be having our traditional wedding ceremony in Kumasi, Ghana on May 22, 2026. It means so much to us to celebrate this day at home, where we come from and where our traditions mean the most. Even though it will be in Ghana, we carry the love and support of our friends and loved ones with us everywhere.

title: The Data Behind US
text:
Mac and Sarah met in school. The initial conditions were simple. Same campus. Same discipline. One TA. One student. Zero expectations. At first, it was just that. A normal friendship that grew out of shared academic space. Nothing dramatic. No hidden variables. Just respect and an easy connection.
 
 
Then life introduced a change in location. Mac moved to the United States for graduate school and strongly recommended that Sarah apply as well. For the record, this recommendation was not random. It was strategic. Sarah got admitted. Same school. Same department. At this point, the sample size of shared experiences increased substantially. Study sessions became frequent. So did conversations about faith, family, and the kind of future they hoped for. The correlation was positive and getting stronger. The model was clearly shifting.



What Sarah did not know was that Mac had been running a long-term analysis for quite some time. Quiet observation. Patient persistence. No premature conclusions. Eventually, the hypothesis was tested.



Mac asked.



Sarah said yes.



My statistically significant other!



Since then, we have been writing a story neither of us saw coming, but both of us now can’t imagine living without. The rest of the data will be collected over a lifetime.

title: Memories
text:
This was February 14, the day Mac finally decided to stop analyzing and just ask Sarah to be his wife. It was simple, intimate and full of heart. And she said yesss!!! The whole day felt light and joyful. It reminded us how far we have come and how much we have grown together.


  



 
  

Here we are at our roommates’ commencement in May 2025. We were so happy and proud of them, but also a little sad knowing they would soon be leaving for different states. It was one of those moments filled with celebration and quiet goodbyes.


  



 
  

This photo was taken on the Missouri River at the Gates of the Mountains in Helena, Montana. We went there with the African Society at MSU for a boat ride and to take in the beautiful mountain views. It was such a peaceful day, just being out on the water and enjoying the scenery together.

  



 
  

We were in Nashville, Tennessee for a conference, and one day we decided to step away from the meetings and explore the city. This photo was taken on a hotel rooftop with the Nashville skyline behind us. It was a nice break from the busy schedule and a chance to just enjoy the moment together.

  



 
  

Our visit to Denver was nothing short of memorable. We had a long nine hour drive from Bozeman to Denver, and along the way we shared some deep and honest conversations about ourselves and where we were headed. The road felt long, but the time together made it special. In Denver, we visited the Museum of Illusions and explored a few other spots around the city. We ended the day at a concert hosted by Davido at the theater. It was one of those trips we will always smile about.

  



 
  

We absolutely loved Salt Lake City. It has the beauty of the mountains and still feels like real city living. This photo was taken at the Utah State Capitol with the views behind us. We spent time at City Creek Center and later explored the nightlife in Salt Lake and Murray.

  



 
  

This is us somewhere in Idaho. We may not remember the exact spot, but we definitely remember the good time.
